info.name: Harbor MCP Gateway
info.description:
Exercises Harbor's MCP endpoint across all 4 pluggable auth strategies (static-token, oauth-2.1, jwt-validation, oauth-introspection), including negative/rejection cases for each. Each request folder documents its own startup prerequisites in its description — Harbor only runs one auth mode at a time per the demo service configs, so folders are meant to be run against the matching server state (see tests/demo_e2e.py for the exact automated sequence this collection mirrors).

Run order for the OAuth-mode folders: the two 'Setup' requests in each folder MUST run first (they populate {{jwtCorrect}}/{{jwtWrongAud}} collection variables consumed by the requests below them) — running the whole folder top-to-bottom via the Postman Runner (or newman) does this automatically.

item.description: Prerequisite: `bash examples/demo/start.sh` — starts Harbor with product/order/tasks enabled (default demo mode).

item.name: Auth — oauth-2.1 (billing)

request.description: Mints a JWT bound to aud=http://localhost:3333 (Harbor's own resource identifier) — the correct audience for both the oauth-2.1 and jwt-validation demo services.

Same signing key and issuer, but the mock AS's confused-deputy request-mapping stamps aud=https://not-harbor.example.com — a same-issuer token minted for a DIFFERENT resource. This must be rejected by resource binding (RFC 8707 / MCP 2026-07-28 §17).

item.name: api_execute(billing) — second call, same token → success

request.description: A second, distinct authenticated tool call with the same token — confirms the auth pass isn't a one-off fluke.

exec: pm.test('status is 200 (tool-level error, not transport error)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.description: Prerequisites: docker compose -f examples/07-oauth/docker-compose.yml up -d; enable services/billing (enabled:true) and disable product/order/tasks; run node examples/demo/billing-service.js; start Harbor with HARBOR_RESOURCE_URI=http://127.0.0.1:3333 and HARBOR_AUTH_SERVERS=http://localhost:8080/default. See tests/demo_e2e.py's _switch_to_oauth_mode()/_start_harbor_oauth() for the exact automated sequence.
